spec_match.rationale: Concepts map the current incomplete Screen Capture Editor's Draft surface (the draft says it is subject to major changes and not intended for implementation): DisplayMediaStreamOptions.audioSelection of type AudioSelectionPreferenceEnum (sole value 'preferred'), a HINT the user agent MAY ignore — never audioPreferred/audioPreference (those names appear only in the feature title and the stale chromestatus summary; the spec member is audioSelection, verified live in the spec and in Chromium's media_stream_constraints.idl L43 [RuntimeEnabled=GetDisplayMediaAudioSelection]). Layers kept separate: options-dictionary acceptance vs user prompt/selection vs returned audio track vs actual selected source vs track settings/capabilities/constraints vs OS audio availability vs preference-vs-guarantee.

interactive.rationale: Real captures only on explicit user clicks (never automatic): the single hinted call with track readback, the with/without-hint comparison runs, and the member-by-member options builder. The comparison and options-inspector stop every returned stream immediately after sampling. Preferred Capture intentionally retains a returned stream for preview/metering until its explicit Stop control or pagehide cleanup. Parent review disables duplicate requests while a picker is pending. getDisplayMedia has no page-level abort signal and its algorithm may stall until the user responds, so only browser UI can complete or dismiss the picker; the page does not offer a fake cancel control.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Index and ledes match delivered concepts and the hint's exact semantics. 'why it shipped' is now 'why the hint exists' plus an exact availability statement: the v152 listing records BOTH Enabled by default and In developer trial for the same feature id, the detail gives desktop 152 with status 'Proposed' (updated 2026-07-22), and Chromium gates the member behind runtime feature GetDisplayMediaAudioSelection (experimental, depends_on GetDisplayMedia). Dictionary acceptance and a pending picker in unflagged Chrome 150 do not establish whether this member was recognized or ignored; parent review removed that unsupported claim.

edge_cases.rationale: The family correctly handles the undetectable-hint problem: options-inspector leads with 'unknown dictionary members are silently dropped — you cannot feature-detect it in JS' (verified: no DisplayMediaStreamOptions or AudioSelectionPreferenceEnum global exists; getSupportedConstraints excludes audioSelection). Rejection and no-audio are reported as distinct outcomes; pending is also explicit because getDisplayMedia exposes no abort signal and the specification permits the picker step to stall. audioSelection support is never inferred from object-literal acceptance, stringify output, a pending picker, UI state, or a generic audio track. A with/without pair is observational and cannot establish causation because user/source/OS state can differ.

references.rationale: All four pages cite ChromeStatus and relevant Screen Capture Editor's Draft anchors. Only the family index cites MDN's getDisplayMedia page (verified 200). WPT note: no dedicated audioSelection test file found under screen-capture/ as of 2026-07-24 (audio-related coverage exists for restrictOwnAudio and permissions-policy); recorded, not inferred.

conformance.rationale: New immutable root suite (this cycle, 8 assertions — 8 JSON entries = 8 rendered rows = 8 reported): MediaDevices/getDisplayMedia prerequisites, a non-vacuous instance-vs-static pair, dictionary/enum binding negatives, supported-constraints exclusion, track inspection, and cleanup. All 8 pass, but these are prerequisite/negative contracts and do NOT prove audioSelection implementation or effect. Direct effect requires an explicitly user-mediated picker comparison, so the suite never auto-requests capture.

runtime_evidence.rationale: chrome-devtools-mcp on HeadlessChrome/150 (2026-07-24): preflight probes and all safe controls exercised at 1280×800 and 390×844 with post-interaction geometry — options builder renders exact JSON per toggle (audioSelection '(omit)' ⇄ 'preferred'), probe lines report callable-with-undetectable-hint honestly, capture buttons entered the real pending-picker state without blind grants. Parent review found that browser picker modality prevents reliable page-control interaction while pending, so it removed proposed Ignore controls rather than simulate cancellation. Each page now suppresses duplicate requests until browser settlement and says browser UI is the only completion/dismissal surface. Revised comparison copy avoids causal claims; zero console errors and zero failed ordinary network requests.

telemetry_health.rationale: Concepts emit showcaseTelemetry.assert events per branch (inspector-run-resolved/fallback, preferred-capture-resolved/fallback, and hintvs-hint/plain-resolved/fallback, with non-sensitive track-presence/options metadata); pending itself emits no false success; telemetry POSTs returned 202 during validation.

design_system.rationale: CSS variables throughout, button background+color pairs, focus-visible styles, no static-card pattern; edits were copy-level and preserve layout.

accessibility.rationale: role=status/aria-live on probes, JSON preview, and result regions; labelled selects with describedby hints; the audio checkbox is label-wrapped; controls are native keyboard-operable buttons.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: Matrix pass including post-interaction states: all four pages scrollWidth equals viewport at 1280×800 and 390×844 after every safe control (toggles, builder changes, button clicks that do not require picker interaction); JSON pre scrolls internally only.

openQuestions.title: Verify the hint's actual picker/track behavior on a GetDisplayMediaAudioSelection-enabled build
openQuestions.detail: This build (HeadlessChrome/150) exposes getDisplayMedia, but object construction and a pending picker cannot reveal whether audioSelection is recognized; no hint effect was verified. On a Chrome 152+ build with the runtime feature on (or where the v152 'Enabled by default' listing entry is operative), verify with real user-driven capture whether picker presentation changes and run repeated controlled with/without trials using the same source and user audio choice. Record track presence separately from source/settings and do not attribute a difference to the hint without a stable repeated comparison. The chromestatus listing records BOTH 'Enabled by default' and 'In developer trial' for this id (detail desktop 152, 'Proposed', updated 2026-07-22) — recheck which category is operative when 152 hits stable.

guidanceConsulted.query: accessible live region announcements for dynamic probe/status results after button activation
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Announce dynamic state through live regions tied to the activating control; label controls and their hints programmatically.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Verified applied: probes/JSON/results use role=status aria-live; selects carry aria-describedby hint text; the audio checkbox is label-wrapped.

guidanceConsulted.query: screen capture requests that require explicit user initiation and honest denial states
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Powerful capture APIs must be user-initiated with clear context, never auto-fired, with rejection, pending-picker, browser-only dismissal, and cleanup treated as first-class states.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Verified applied strictly: every getDisplayMedia() call in the family is behind an explicit button; sample-only streams are stopped immediately, the live preview has explicit Stop/pagehide cleanup, pending calls suppress duplicates and explicitly direct dismissal to browser UI; no fake page-level cancel is offered. Rejection/no-audio are never faked or auto-retried.
guidanceConsulted.evidence: interaction log — zero capture requests outside explicit clicks

summary: Source-review of the audioSelection-in-getDisplayMedia family against the current incomplete Screen Capture Editor's Draft (DisplayMediaStreamOptions.audioSelection : AudioSelectionPreferenceEnum — sole value 'preferred'; 'The user agent MAY ignore this hint'), Chromium's media_stream_constraints.idl (L43 [RuntimeEnabled=GetDisplayMediaAudioSelection] — the exact receiver/gate), the direct chromestatus detail (updated 2026-07-22: v152 listing records BOTH Enabled by default and In developer trial for this id; detail desktop 152 'Proposed'), and MDN (getDisplayMedia page 200; no audioSelection-specific WPT file found). The family correctly recognized that dictionary acceptance cannot detect the hint and never auto-requested capture, but parent review removed unsupported gate-off/equivalent-behavior claims, made with/without results observational rather than causal, and added explicit pending-state and duplicate-suppression handling without pretending page script can dismiss the picker. Hardened: index renamed 'why the hint exists' with an exact dual-listing/Proposed/experimental-gate availability statement. Added the immutable root suite (8 assertions incl. the no-dictionary-global, no-enum-global, and supported-constraints-exclusion traps that encode WHY the hint is JS-undetectable). Missing-suite denominator 5→4 expected (794/798).
